title: The Portrait of Saint Alder's
author: Jonah Ashgrove
blurb: Rafael Halloran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
